mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, sequence_no, status, claim_owner, claim_until, next_attempt_at, published_at, attempts, last_error, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_event_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now})) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
